nodes.question: What principles are challenging to implement across different countries?
nodes.answer: The principles related to Transformative Change are challenging to implement due to the varying government and governance systems in different countries.
nodes.paragraph: Of course, these principles are and will be challenging to implement across the countries of the world with different government and governance systems. But for the first time the assess - ment lays out the thinking behind what is Transformative Change and what it means to implement it (O Brien et al. 2024 ; fig. SPM 2). An innovation is the inclusion in the SPM of a checklist which will allow all interested to check the transformative potential of policies, projects and other initiatives across all sectors. Intensive use of this checklist would be a first step into the right direction. nodes.question: What practical recommendations does the study offer to organizations?
nodes.answer: The study offers practical recommendations for organizations seeking to implement digital technologies to achieve more sustainable and efficient production systems.
nodes.paragraph: 2020; Sica et al. 2022) Moving from this background, this research aims to develop a deeper and more critical understanding of the integration of DTs into LCA, outlining both the opportuni- ties and challenges associated with circular strategies. To this end, this research questions existing assumptions and develops new research perspectives. Emerging positions from the literature regarding the role of DTs for LCA studies are discussed, with a specific focus on the Life Cycle Inven- tory (LCI). Specifically, the research questions that guided the study are the following: RQ1: What circular loops are addressed when digital technologies are integrated into the development of a Life Cycle Inventory? RQ2: What trade-offs are revealed in the integration of digital technologies in Life Cycle Inventory development addressing circularity along a life cycle? The findings of this study are expected to contribute to the existing body of knowledge on LCA by providing detailed insights into how DTs can enhance the development of LCI, promoting the business circular transition. Additionally, the study offers practical recommendations for organisations seeking to implement these technologies to achieve more sustainable and efficient production systems.

nodes.question: What are the organizational implications of digital transformation in industrial practice according to Golfer and Fritzsche (2017)?
nodes.answer: The organizational implications include the need for data-driven operations management, changes in workforce skill sets, and adaptations to new technologies for improved efficiency.

nodes.question: What are some digital transformation models for the Industry 4.0 transition according to Bellantuono et al. (2021)?
nodes.answer: According to Bellantuono et al. (2021), lessons from the change management literature can provide insights into digital transformation models for the Industry 4.0 transition.

nodes.question: What are the organizational implications of the digital transformation in industrial practice for data-driven operations management?
nodes.answer: The organizational implications of the digital transformation in industrial practice for data-driven operations management include changes in processes, workforce skills, and technology adoption to leverage data for strategic decision-making and operational efficiency.
